study: Same-protocol analytic baselines and paired drift compensation
dataset: CIFAR-100, 100 classes, 10 sequential tasks, 10 clients, Dirichlet alpha 0.05, seed 0
manifest: Existing frozen seed0 from the completed November 10 ablation
backbone: Same exact pretrained ViT-B/16 augreg_in21k state and common image transforms as the completed sequence
primary: Raw global all-seen AIA, arithmetic mean of the ten stage accuracies
secondary: fixed task-block centered AIA and T10
paired_primary_contrasts: pure RRS/full minus FedRAN and STSA-E respectively
translation: For ten clients, transmit the sample count and FP32 vector mean of post-aggregation CLS minus task-start CLS on identical current training images. Server pools by sample count. It adds one common shift to every saved old mean and retains old scatter. The first three branches and new classes are unchanged. Each branch independently carries task-start historical state; the shared run computes all four on the same training and evaluation tensors.

analytic_baselines.t1_policy: STSA ViT AdaptFormer parallel scale 0.1, adapter width64, cosine head, SGD momentum .9, uniform FedAvg and round-wise cosine. Reuse this same completed T1 model for the two analytic methods and freeze it after T1. Their analytic heads, random features and statistics are independent.
analytic_baselines.stsa_e_choices: Paper ViT config with ten dummy shards per client; released demo main.py shows five. Use released coefficient clamps, within-client random contiguous shards after permutation, and cosine scoring on the fitted ridge weights. Sum/count packets are FP64/int64, and the downlink analytic head is FP32.
analytic_baselines.fedran_choices: Fully supervised v2 Algorithms 1–3 reimplementation, Gaussian N(0,1) plus ReLU, local truncated SVD and sequential spatial plus temporal QR-SVD. Algorithm-reported width and rank. T1 adaptation matches STSA's shared entry as in the v2 ViT comparison. Author repository linked from v1 returned 404; numerical lambda is unspecified in v2, so fix lambda=1e6 with the same unscaled projection convention as the STSA-E ViT configuration. No sweep. Use unnormalized v2 Eq. 11 ridge logits and FP32 finite wire precision.
analytic_baselines.alignment: Exact common manifest, pretrained checkpoint, preprocessing, labels and evaluator. Baselines retain their first-task schedules and their declared classifier rules. The five-round pure RRS adaptation budget is not imposed on the analytic methods.

verification: CPU transport, wire and analytic matrix checks; real ViT synthetic shared-vs-standalone branch isolation; ten pure RRS task checkpoint readbacks and final post-merge check; both analytic final checkpoint readbacks. Compare old three official raw/centered confusion trajectories stage by stage as a reproduction check and report discrepancies without replacing any result.
stop: End after complete receipts and checks, or on the original hard clock, storage or GPU limit. No early stop based on evaluation scores, hyperparameter or seed searches. On engineering failure retain evidence and original budget. No old data or existing outputs are modified.
communication_caveat: Count declared messages separately per method and charge shared research computation once. No physical network measurement; pretrained checkpoint broadcast and framing/retries excluded.
